verdict.rationale: Brex docs confirm virtual card creation (bill-pay, corporate-cards) and spend controls/limits including procurement-specific limits (budgets API, expense-management limits), which together support single-vendor virtual cards for SaaS/procurement spend. However, no evidence explicitly documents a 'lock card to one vendor' feature or merchant-lock enforcement mechanism, only general limit/budget controls. Missing for 10: explicit vendor-lock/merchant-restriction documentation, and independent confirmation of this specific control working as described.
